structs.notes: Partial with size 3232. Replay touches the refdef up to offset 3232. R_RenderScene and R_CopyViewStateSnapshot prove the layout from 0 to 1144 and show that the radiant block is absent. The tail is not a clean GT shift past 2832, so the builder 2960 is refuted. Members with no Replay evidence stay in pads. Downstream proposals for the coordinator: (1) cg_t.refdef (offset 26624, unsigned __int8[3232]) can become refdef_t once 3232 is accepted, same size, no shift; (2) PipDef.pipRefDef is refdef_t at offset 0 of a 129440-byte PipDef, so refdef_t 69536 -> 3232 changes PipDef's pipEnabled (69536) and all later PipDef members, which is a parent size change for the PipDef owner; (3) the refdef copy in R_CopyViewStateSnapshot is a snapshot of refdef, and its destination struct (m_ptr, dst+2612 etc.) is not this struct. Renames: none proven.
